lines.zh: 我走过来，脚下的路变了。
lines.en: I walk over and the road changes under me.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，出口就少一个。
lines.en: Every step removes an exit.
I'm not in a hurry. You are.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，换了地方。
lines.en: I follow, and the place is different.
The further you go, the stranger it gets.
I cross the threshold and the door shuts.
The sky here has already darkened.
Step by step, I send you off.
You look back. The road is wrong.
I needn't touch you. Following is enough.
I've changed the rules here.
I stand and watch you.
I'm working out where you'll go.
Time here doesn't follow you.
I stay perfectly still. That unnerves you.
The air here is faintly sweet.
I wait for you to step across.
The door frame is a little crooked.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
Your shadow is longer here.
I'm watching the ground under your feet.
There's an old smell about this place.
I've stood beside you a long while.
I know this direction well.
You've walked to where I am.

lines.zh: 你看看这条路，还一样吗？
lines.en: Look at this road. Still the same?

lines.zh: 我能让你去更深的地方。
lines.en: I can send you somewhere deeper.

lines.zh: 你身边的东西开始不对。
lines.en: Things around you are starting to be wrong.

lines.zh: 你的东西还带着上一处。
lines.en: You still carry the last place on you.
Look at me and I'll take you along.

lines.zh: 这扇门后面不是你家的门。
lines.en: That door isn't the one from your home.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在这里会消失。
lines.en: Your footprints vanish here.
I'm counting how many paths you have left.

lines.zh: 你转身看看，路已经变了。
lines.en: Turn and see. The road has changed.
No rush. Go wherever you like.

lines.zh: 你手上那盏灯，撑不了多久。
lines.en: That lamp won't last long.

lines.zh: 你带的东西在这里都不重。
lines.en: What you carry weighs nothing here.

lines.zh: 我换个位置，你就迷糊了。
lines.en: I move, and you lose your bearings.
First time here, isn't it?

lines.zh: 你的同伴已经不在这一层。
lines.en: Your companion isn't on this level anymore.

lines.zh: 我站在这一头，另一头是别处。
lines.en: I stand on this end. The other end is elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你看久了，会认不出回去的路。
lines.en: Stare long enough and you'll lose the way back.

lines.zh: 我一动，这里的形状就变。
lines.en: When I move, the shape of this place changes.

lines.zh: 别急着走，让我看清楚你。
lines.en: Don't hurry. Let me see you clearly.

lines.zh: 这点伤，换个地方就没了。
lines.en: This wound disappears in another place.

lines.zh: 你的东西在这里不太管用。
lines.en: Your things work poorly here.
I stepped back and the road narrowed.
That didn't push me back.
I swayed and the road bent.
You're still on this road.
This body isn't very solid.
I can tell you tried hard.
I don't stop. I keep watching.
This place took half of it.

lines.zh: 这些在这里都不算东西。
lines.en: None of that counts as anything here.
What would you trade for the way back?
I don't eat. I trade.

lines.zh: 放下它，你可能走得更远。
lines.en: Put it down. You might get further.
Your hand shakes. So does the road.
That will grow lighter here.

lines.zh: 你举着的，是上一处的光。
lines.en: That's light from the last place.
Bring it closer. I won't touch it.
Still thinking about going back?
It can't buy what you want.
Touch me and the place changes.

lines.zh: 你脚下这一块不是刚才的。
lines.en: This block under you isn't the same one.

lines.zh: 我让了一下，你还在原地吗？
lines.en: I moved aside. Are you still in place?
Your armor feels cold here.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔了一层东西。
lines.en: There's a layer between us.
Not too close. You'll step across.
You step back and the door is gone.

lines.zh: 我碰到你的袖子，地方就动。
lines.en: I touch your sleeve and the place shifts.
Are you still in the room you were in?
The ground here isn't firm.
Not here. Not this.
Two of me would open two roads.

lines.zh: 我们的形状会互相错开。
lines.en: Our shapes slip past each other.
The place it sends to is more familiar.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，路就断了。
lines.en: Together, the road breaks.
There's no space between.
Afterwards, two directions.
This motion has no before or after.

lines.zh: 你已经不在这条路上了。
lines.en: You're no longer on this road.
I pick up something you brought.
Here it has turned into something else.

lines.zh: 这块石头是别的世界的。
lines.en: This stone belongs to another world.
What you drop changes too.
Hold it and the road gets longer.
I keep it for the next place.
The soil here doesn't know it.

lines.zh: 我手里这件东西还在响。
lines.en: What I'm holding is still ringing.

lines.zh: 你少了一件，我多了一件。
lines.en: You have one less. I have one more.

lines.zh: 你站在该站的位置上了。
lines.en: You're standing where you should.

lines.zh: 我找到你了，不用找太久。
lines.en: Found you. It didn't take long.

lines.zh: 这一步我等的就是你踩。
lines.en: That step is the one I waited for.

lines.zh: 你身边的门已经换成别的。
lines.en: The door beside you is a different one now.
Once I look, the road is fixed.

lines.zh: 你要去的地方我挑好了。
lines.en: I've picked where you're going.

lines.zh: 你身上有上一处的味道。
lines.en: You carry the last place's scent.

lines.zh: 这里的边界就在你脚下。
lines.en: The boundary is right under your feet.
You have only one path left.

lines.zh: 那扇门我给它换了后面。
lines.en: I changed what's behind that door.

lines.zh: 你的灯在这里照不到底。
lines.en: Your light doesn't reach the bottom here.

lines.zh: 别退，退回去也不是原处。
lines.en: Don't back up. Behind isn't where it was.
I've stretched this stretch of road.

lines.zh: 你听见风了吗？那不是风。
lines.en: Heard the wind? That's not wind.

lines.zh: 这一边归我，那一边也是。
lines.en: This side is mine. So is that.
I've come to take you over the boundary.
I follow you. The road follows me.

lines.zh: 你换了几次方向，都没出去。
lines.en: You changed direction. You never left.
I wait ahead for you to come round.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在这里留不下。
lines.en: Your prints don't stay here.
I altered this stretch just now.

lines.zh: 你一回头，门就换了一扇。
lines.en: You look back and the door is different.

lines.zh: 这边的天色不跟着时间来。
lines.en: The light here doesn't follow time.
The light you see is only half of it.
I'm always within three steps.

lines.zh: 你走进来的路已经没了。
lines.en: The way you came in is gone.

lines.zh: 我再走一步，你就过界了。
lines.en: One more step from me and you cross.
Everything here is slower than I am.
You're walking in my place.
I don't chase. The doors close.

lines.zh: 你数着房间吗？会数错的。
lines.en: Counting rooms? You'll miscount.
I stood at the fork without moving.

lines.zh: 你带着的指南针在乱转。
lines.en: The compass you carry is spinning.

lines.zh: 这段路只通向一个地方。
lines.en: This road leads one place.
I haven't delivered you yet.
The further you go, the less like here it is.
One touch and you've moved.
That wasn't harm. It was a swap.
The ground changed under you.

lines.zh: 你退了两格，回头路没了。
lines.en: You stepped back. The way back is gone.

lines.zh: 我把你从这条路拿下来了。
lines.en: I took you off this road.
Everything near you is swapping.
I push and you land elsewhere.
That changed your direction.

lines.zh: 你的护甲还在，地方不在。
lines.en: Your armor's the same. The place isn't.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手，路就断了。
lines.en: I hold your hand and the road breaks.
You fell through and landed upright.
There's no echo here anymore.
I lend a hand and send you further.

lines.zh: 你已经不在刚才那间屋。
lines.en: You're not in that room anymore.

lines.zh: 这一击留着开下一扇门。
lines.en: That one opens the next door.
Are you still standing there?
I stand between two places.
You walked in, and here I am.
There was no door here before.
I arrived when the light came on.
I've taken the road behind me.
I watch the edge of this level.
When I appeared, the clock lagged.
That sound was a door.
The shadow on the ground changed shape.
I laid this stretch of road.
I've been in this corner.
I came from the last place.
The wind here blows inward.
I've counted what you carry.

lines.zh: 你回头看的那一眼有点晚。
lines.en: You looked back a little too late.
I'm standing in a different spot.

lines.zh: 这条路的尽头是另一条路。
lines.en: The end of this road is another road.

lines.zh: 我在两扇门中间出现了。
lines.en: I appeared between two doors.
The sound of the tiles changed.

lines.zh: 我把这里认成了那一处。
lines.en: I mistook this for that other place.
Fire burns slowly here.
I fell and landed elsewhere.
Water flooded this road.
The blast reshaped the place.
The arrow stuck in the wrong wall.

lines.zh: 这道光把虚实换了一下。
lines.en: That light swapped real and unreal.
I don't need to eat.

lines.zh: 雷把两处照成一模一样。
lines.en: Lightning made both places look alike.
The void was always my road.
